ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New business, Brief and scope and later stages need Brief received, Service lines and Engagement type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_business", CASE(StageName, "Lead", 1, "Discovery", 2, "Brief and scope", 3, "Proposal sent (New business)", 4, "Pitch or review", 5, "Negotiation (New business)", 6, "Closed won", 7, 0) >= 3, OR(NOT(Brief_received__c), ISBLANK(Service_lines__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Engagement_type__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Brief received, Service lines and Engagement type before moving to Brief and scope.
